hero.name: Pullaiah
hero.title: Senior Data Analyst · Power BI · Microsoft Fabric · Azure
hero.headline: Ten years of building BI that people trust — clean semantic models, fast reports, and root-cause fixes that hold. Currently on the Insights team at ABC Fitness Solutions.

experienceIntro: Ten years across Infosys → LTIMindtree → ABC Fitness Insights. Click a stop on the timeline or use ← → keys.

points: Lead root-cause investigations across Insights Reporting — Power BI semantic models, SSRS paginated reports, Synapse / Azure SQL, and ADF pipelines.
Trace data gaps source-first — staging → ETL stored procedures → reporting layer, validated across many locations and edge cases before any fix is proposed.
Build and harden reporting logic — DAX measures, model relationships, and paginated-report dataset queries for fitness operations analytics (membership, payments, revenue, check-ins).
Partner with Data Engineering on production fixes — stored procedure and view changes, schema impact analysis, pipeline mapping checks, and proof queries.
Communicate findings to product and support — concise summaries plus technical write-ups, and mentor teammates on investigation practices.

experience.role: Senior Data Analyst / Fabric Engineer | Specialist — Data Engineering
points: Led Power BI and Microsoft Fabric delivery — for Fortune 500 clients across Product, Finance, and Executive stakeholders, including sprint planning, scrum ceremonies, and technical documentation.
Architected large semantic models — up to ~110GB, with performance tuning, incremental refresh, and gateway stability work that kept scheduled refreshes reliable.
Automated model operations — Tabular Editor and C# scripts for repeatable changes; designed star schemas and DAX calculation groups to simplify measures and speed up reports.
Built and managed Azure Data Factory pipelines — the feeds behind enterprise semantic models.
Delivered NLP and text analytics in live dashboards — sentiment and text-mining visuals, with row-level security, governed workspaces, and training playbooks for global users.
Mentored junior analysts — training on Power BI, Azure, and NLP techniques.

experience.role: Power BI Developer / Data Analyst / Data Engineer | Engineering Lead
points: Designed and delivered 40+ dashboards — analytical models across multiple business units, serving 150+ global users.
Engineered Incremental Refresh — for semantic models up to ~40GB, improving refresh stability; automated manual reporting and cut stakeholder effort by ~60%.
Migrated Tableau prototypes to production Power BI — authored knowledge bases, trained 20+ analysts, and ran end-user workshops that reduced support queries.
Built ETL and dataflows — SQL / MySQL with Azure integrations, plus data-quality checks (null and outlier validation, reconciliation).
Versioning and performance tuning — DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, and ALM Toolkit as the standard toolchain.

skillsIntro: Core stack from the resume, plus day-to-day Insights tooling. Hover to explore.
